description: ÖREB cadastre extract for the land parcel at a point (WGS84) or by EGRID: which restriction themes concern the parcel (land-use zoning, building lines, noise sensitivity, groundwater protection, contaminated sites, …), each restriction with legend text, legal status, affected area/percentage and links to the legal provisions; plus the themes that do NOT concern it. Includes the link to the official PDF extract (the only legally binding version). Use geocode first for an address. Example: {lat: 47.3769, lon: 8.5417}.

lang.description: Language of the extract (cantons publish de/fr/it; others fall back)

name: get_land_restrictions
title: Public-law restrictions on a parcel (ÖREB)
